stem: Which one of the following locations has “Blood Rain”.
expl: Sirocco is a warm, dry and dusty wind blowing from Sahara Desert to the Mediterranean Sea. This wind carries red sand with it. This wind sometimes causes rain in Italy. When the red sand falls to the earth with the raindrops, it is called Blood Rain.

stem: What about the Chinook winds over the Central plains of the United state what effect?

options.label: d
options.text: There is no effect on temperature.

expl: The meaning of 'Chinook' is 'Snow Eater'. It is a warm and dry wind descending along the eastern slopes of the Rocky Mountains, blowing from the southern part of Colorado to the Southern part of British Columbia in Canada. Due to its effects, the temperature in summer increases snow melts and green grass grows even in winter. It is beneficial for cattle rearers, as it makes the pasture snow-free.

stem: Dry winds blowing from north-east and east to west of Sahara desert are known as :
expl: In the Sahara Desert, dry winds blowing from the northeast and east to the west are known as Harmattan winds. These are cool, dry winds far their invigorating dryness they are also referred to as the "Doctor Wind".
